{"id":1832270418,"question_id":4090,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763382110,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1832270418/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum String Length After Balanced Removals","memory":"16.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minLengthAfterRemovals(string s) {\n        stack<pair<int,int>>st;\n        int count = 1;\n        for(int i=0 ; i<s.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(!st.empty() and s[i] == st.top().first)\n            {\n                st.top().second++;\n            }\n            else if(!st.empty() and s[i] != st.top().first)\n            {\n                if(st.top().second == 1) st.pop();\n                else \n                    st.top().second--;\n                count = 1;\n            }\n            else\n                st.push({s[i] , count++});\n        }\n    return st.size() == 1 ? st.top().second : st.size();\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-string-length-after-balanced-removals","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1133}
